mechanism_class: real-yield-driven (real component of the nominal/real decomposition - TIPS real-yield curve structure, NOT the inflation-expectations component used by FXFV5-A5-P1)

mechanism.one_line: Vintaged US real-yield CURVE-STRUCTURE weekly drift: a weekly change in the TIPS real-curve slope (DFII5 minus DFII10) is a revised expected-short-real-rate path that global real-money allocators (pension LDI, real-return-mandate funds, monthly rebalancing cycles) monetize with a settlement lag, so spot USD drifts for about one week in the direction of the real tightening/easing impulse; the anchor holds each weekly decision for 5 sessions, non-overlapping.

mechanism_before_parameter.who_is_forced_to_trade_or_slow_to_react: The slow side is real-money: LDI and real-return allocators rebalance monthly and their hedging ratios adjust after flows settle; systematic FX accounts re-weight weekly. A move in the real curve that changes expected short-real-rate paths therefore translates into capital reallocation over 1-2 weeks, not instantly; the fast side (rates desks pricing TIPS) has no FX mandate.
mechanism_before_parameter.why_the_effect_exists: The real curve slope embeds the market's expected short-real-rate path; a structural weekly move in it changes real-return differentials that drive bond-flow-driven FX (pull factor) with a persistence of weeks. This is a level-structure (term-structure) variable in the REAL segment - a different market, a different horizon, and a different statistic from both policy-rate carry levels and 5-day breakeven shocks.
mechanism_before_parameter.observable: Weekly same-sign FX drift following extreme weekly changes in the as-of real-curve slope; PIT-testable per decision row because each read is restricted to rows whose ALFRED realtime_start vintage precedes the decision.
mechanism_before_parameter.when_it_must_fail: (1) When slope moves are TIPS financing/liquidity-technical rather than expectations (dealers' balance-sheet cycles, auction settlement) - no real-path content, book degrades to noise. (2) When real-yield structure is already the market's dominant attention object and is impounded same-week (large parts of 2022-25 inside S0) - the drift window collapses and the frozen folds expose the regime dependence. (3) If the 'real' claim is fake and the book is really a yield-level/carry-direction book, the nominal-yield-level placebo control reproduces the anchor and the family dies in-run.
mechanism_before_parameter.control_that_kills_the_convenient_explan: Causal control arm = nominal-yield-level placebo: decisions from the sign of DGS10 relative to its trailing 104-week median, same weekly clock, same lag, same hold. Yield level is the carry-adjacent explanation ('high US nominal yields pull capital'); if that placebo reproduces the anchor, the real-curve-structure claim is dead and the family fails via CONTROL_REPRODUCES_MECHANISM - this directly polices the closed carry region from inside the run, not only via the D2 rho bar.

signal_definition.series: ALFRED DFII5 (5-Year Treasury Inflation-Indexed Security, Constant Maturity) and DFII10 (10-Year), daily vintaged; DGS10 (10-Year nominal constant maturity) used ONLY by the placebo control arm
signal_definition.slope: s(t) = DFII5_vint(t) - DFII10_vint(t) (front-minus-long real yield; an INCREASE in s = front real rates rising relative to the long end = real tightening impulse), all reads strictly as-of decision time
signal_definition.weekly_change: ds(t) = s(t) - s(t - 5 sessions) measured at the weekly decision bar, z-scored over the trailing 104 weekly observations as-of t (no backfill)
signal_definition.decision_rule: z(t) > 0 (real tightening impulse) -> LONG the USD leg of every authorized pair; z(t) < 0 -> SHORT the USD leg; z == 0 or no eligible vintage -> no decision (NO_EVAL, never backfilled). Sign-only, no thresholds, no sizing weights.

universe_note: runner notation EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY, USD/CHF, USD/CAD, AUD/USD, NZD/USD; common US signal across pairs makes pair_concentration (<=40%) and dropout (>=6/8) the honest concentration police

data_source.vintage_semantics: TRUE as-of per row: every series row must carry its ALFRED realtime_start vintage stamp; a decision at time t may read only rows with realtime_start <= t, mirroring the inherited PolicyRateReader as-of gating (missing eligible vintage -> None/NO_EVAL, never backfilled). The revision test - comparing the same observation_date across at least two distinct vintages - is the ONLY provable PIT check and is mandatory before S0; DFII series carry known vintage revisions, and if the successor probe measures zero revisions across S0 the PIT claim is unprovable and the cell is BLOCKED, not scored.

decision_clock.clock: weekly: the first completed 16:00 America/New_York session bar of each week (Monday; on a Monday holiday the next session bar), inherited DST-aware calendar and weekend gate
decision_clock.slower_or_equal_daily: weekly is strictly slower than daily - satisfies the frozen daily-or-slower scope rule

warmup.consequence: first decisions ~2020-04 given S0 start 2018-04-04; fold 0 partially populated (2020-04..2022-05), folds 1 and 2 populated; ~270 weekly decisions x 7 pairs expected, far above the 40-decision floor; for the runner's per-pair-day alpha window the equivalent warmup_daily_bars is declared so the a5_per_pair_day_normalized_v1 window is computed identically

features: 104-week rolling stdev of the weekly slope change (all as-of)
DGS10 vintaged level for the placebo arm only
features_and_lags.lags: decision at t uses vintages strictly available before t; entry bar is the next completed session bar after the decision (one-event-lag); no same-bar fills (ONE_EVENT_LAG_VIOLATION fatal)
features_and_lags.forbidden_inputs: no policy-rate series, no CPI prints, no announcement-ledger conditioning, no price-derived features other than entry/exit execution prices; DGS10 never enters the anchor feature stack

entry_exit_fills.entry: next completed 16:00-NY session bar after the weekly decision (market order at that bar); one position per pair max, non-overlapping weekly books (no pyramiding); weekend gate inherited
entry_exit_fills.exit: at the entry bar of the following week's cycle (5-session hold, market order at that bar's 16:00-NY close); non-overlapping by construction - no overlapping-dependence inflation of the fold statistics
entry_exit_fills.force_flat: fold-boundary force-flat per the inherited runner; trades spanning the 2022-05-01 internal boundary are refused (FOLD_FORCE_FLAT_VIOLATION)

costs.frozen_schedule: cost = notional * (1.5 bps * tier) / 10000, charged ONCE per fill side, notional 10000 USD-units, tiers {1.0, 1.5, 2.0}; costs are never softened (blanket clause: no fee/cost assumptions below the frozen 1.5 bps x {1.0,1.5,2.0} authority)
costs.stress_booking: F1-fixed: booked PnL RE-COMPUTED at each tier's per-side cost on the SAME trades; tier rows pairwise distinct, kernel fails closed (STRESS_ROWS_NOT_DISTINCT); fill-delay stress carried unblended
costs.dual_books: price_only_pnl_usd and financing_adjusted_pnl_usd as separate immutable digest-covered columns; the price-only sign is never inverted; FINANCING_MANUFACTURES_EDGE gate live; financing adjustments carried by the family with the inherited frozen formula, never invented by the runner
costs.break_even_publication: break-even bps from the same cost kernel, 6-decimal convention, published per cell

arms.anchor: sign of the as-of weekly change in the DFII5-DFII10 real-curve slope (z>0 long USD, z<0 short USD), weekly clock, 5-session hold, as specified
arms.neighbour: same mechanism, 10-session (bi-weekly) slope-change window at the same weekly clock and hold; must SUPPORT the anchor or NEIGHBOUR_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_ANCHOR fails the family - a robustness neighbour, not a second mechanism
arms.causal_control: nominal-yield-level placebo: decisions from the sign of DGS10 relative to its trailing 104-week median, same weekly clock, same lag, same hold; it RUNS TO COMPLETION under the same evidenced semantics and must FAIL - reproduction (CONTROL_REPRODUCES_MECHANISM) proves the book is a yield-level/carry-direction trade, not real-curve structure, and kills the family from inside the run
arms.benchmark_treatment: inherited required benchmark arm per the runner contract (not a scored cell); alpha definition declared as a5_per_pair_day_normalized_v1 with the equivalent daily warmup declared in meta

falsification_rule.frozen_stage_a_gates: any of EXPECTANCY_NONPOSITIVE, PF_BELOW_1.10, FEWER_THAN_2_POSITIVE_POPULATED_FOLDS, POPULATED_FOLD_PF_BELOW_0.80, MDD_ABOVE_FROZEN_CEILING, PAIR_CONCENTRATION_ABOVE_40PCT, POSITIVE_FOLD_SHARE_ABOVE_50PCT, STRESS_TIER_1.5_FAIL, STRESS_TIER_2.0_FAIL (primary), DROPOUT_SURVIVAL_BELOW_6_OF_8, USD_DRIFT_EXPLAINS_ANCHOR, DECISION_FLOOR_NOT_MET, INCREMENTAL_ALPHA_NOT_POSITIVE, FINANCING_MANUFACTURES_EDGE -> family falsified, scored negative recorded
falsification_rule.mechanism_sanity: neighbour must support the anchor; the nominal-yield-level control must fail - CONTROL_REPRODUCES_MECHANISM or NEIGHBOUR_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_ANCHOR -> family falsified
falsification_rule.vintage_shuffle_mutation_iq: at I/Q, the availability-lag mutation test on the conditioning series is a vintage-shuffled read (seeded frozen mapping, same construction standard as FXFV5-A5-P1's control): if the anchor's gate status survives the shuffle, the PIT information linkage was inert -> family fails
falsification_rule.revision_test: zero vintaged revisions across S0 for DFII5/DFII10 -> PIT distinctness unprovable -> BLOCKED (never scored as a pass)
falsification_rule.ancestry_rho_bar: at D2, measured Spearman rho of the anchor decision vector vs BOTH V3 family2 anchor variants (as-scored and evidenced-corrected books) AND vs the V4 family1 commodity-bloc anchor must satisfy |rho| <= 0.20; above the bar the cell dies pre-selection with no appeal

expected_failure_interpretation.scored_negative: a first-class honest result: vintaged real-yield curve structure carries no after-cost incremental information for weekly-or-slower FX books under the frozen gates; NOT a sign-flip opportunity, NOT a threshold-neighbour rescue target (blanket clauses bind); recorded, not repaired
expected_failure_interpretation.stress_tier_kill: if base tier passes but tier 2.0 (primary) kills it, the class is thin-margin per P-2 and the kill is recorded with per-gate margins; a knife-edge pass, if it occurs, is recorded as knife-edge
expected_failure_interpretation.placebo_reproduction: the nominal-yield-level control reproducing the anchor is the most informative possible failure: it proves the 'real structure' was nominal yield level in disguise - a carry-adjacent trade inside a closed region - and the family is rejected with that finding recorded
expected_failure_interpretation.usd_drift_fire: the honest reading is USD-index beta, not real-rate information - the family is rejected
expected_failure_interpretation.modal_ex_ante_outcome: given a weekly drift class against 3.0 bps base round-trip cost, and the post-2022 high-attention real-rate regime inside S0, the modal ex-ante outcome is a scored negative or a fold-concentration/stress kill - a correct negative is a successful research run (P-6)

decorrelation_from_carry_ex_ante.carry_ancestor: V3 family2 FXFV3-A6-P1: realized-vol regime-gated POLICY-RATE-DIFFERENTIAL LEVEL carry (BIS WS_CBPOL); decision = static differential sign, essentially constant per pair for months; front door CLOSED at D2 of V4 by measured rho 0.997-1.000 vs both invalidated-ancestor variants
decorrelation_from_carry_ex_ante.this_mechanism: decision = sign of a WEEKLY CHANGE in the TIPS real-curve slope (DFII5 - DFII10) - a market-based, forward-looking term-structure statistic in the REAL segment, not a policy-rate level; the decision sign flips on sub-quarter scale (weekly slope changes cross zero constantly), whereas carry decisions are near-static; the carry information set (WS_CBPOL) is not an input anywhere in the feature stack, and the in-run nominal-yield-level placebo arm exists precisely to kill the yield-level/carry explanation if it is the true driver
decorrelation_from_carry_ex_ante.ex_ante_expectation: rho expected low by construction (flipping weekly sign vs near-static sign); the claim is nonetheless EMPIRICAL, not rhetorical: the |rho| <= 0.20 bar vs both ancestor variants is a binding pre-selection kill-switch
decorrelation_from_carry_ex_ante.not_a_relabel_statement: this proposal is not the V3 anchor with a new label, not a realized-vol regime gate in new clothes, not a threshold/window variant of any forbidden row, and not a sign inversion of any rejected family
